courses.summary: 光子封裝熱機耦合分析以熱場、翹曲、界面和光模式的耦合連結元件物理與系統驗證。此代表地點用於認識研究與封裝供應鏈；課程由多個公開來源交叉編寫。
courses.summaryEn: Thermomechanical analysis of photonic packages links device physics and system validation through coupled temperature fields, warpage, interfaces and optical modes. This representative location illustrates the research and packaging ecosystem; the curriculum draws on several public sources.
courses.connection: 以熱場、翹曲、界面和光模式的耦合比較相關工法；重新核對材料、波段、控制拓撲與驗收門檻。
courses.connectionEn: Compare related methods through coupled temperature fields, warpage, interfaces and optical modes, rechecking materials, wavelength, control topology and acceptance limits.

history.title: 熱分析接到光學模型
history.text: Ansys 的公開熱調波導範例把溫度分布傳到光學求解器。本課再以獨立假想封裝問題比較幾何與材料擾動，並不宣稱該範例已驗證任一封裝。
history.textEn: Ansys publicly demonstrates transferring temperature fields to an optical solver. This course independently compares geometry and material perturbations in a hypothetical package; that example does not validate a particular package.

history.year: 設計延伸（未標年） / Undated design context
history.title: 封裝介面成為共同模型
history.text: AIM 的 ADK 提供把組裝介面帶入設計的脈絡。本課由此要求熱與機械分析保留相同材料、幾何及邊界版本，避免跨模型拼接失真。
history.textEn: AIM ADK provides assembly-interface context. This course consequently requires matched material, geometry and boundary revisions across thermal/mechanical models to avoid inconsistent coupling.
